mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in real GDP growth below 1.5% signals weakening aggregate demand, which depresses corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant negative correlation between GDPC1 growth below 1.5% and S&P 500 20d returns (p > 0.10), or the mechanism fails to predict negative returns in at least 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index above 2% signals accelerating supply-side growth, which boosts corporate profit margins and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20d returns in periods of accelerating INDPRO growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 5.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows no significant negative correlation between FEDFUNDS > 5.5% and S&P 500 20d returns (p > 0.10), or the mechanism fails to predict negative returns in at least 60% of triggered instances.
